chunk.content: In Chinese fish markets, the yellow drum sells at a price similar to that of the large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea).
chunk.source_quote: The market price of the yellow drum is similar to that of the large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea), which is another popular fish sold in local Chinese fish markets.

source.title: Chromosome-scale assembly and high-density genetic map of the yellow drum, Nibea albiflora (Scientific Data; doi:10.1038/s41597-021-01045-z)
